statement: Saudi Arabia or the Saudi-led coalition carries out at least one air or missile strike on Houthi-controlled Yemen between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25.
resolution: TRUE if at least two of Reuters, AP and AFP report a Saudi or Saudi-led coalition air or missile strike on Houthi-controlled Yemen occurring between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25.
failure_condition: No Saudi or Saudi-led coalition air or missile strike hits Houthi-controlled Yemen between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25.

statement: At least one merchant vessel is attacked, struck by a projectile, boarded or seized in the Strait of Hormuz, the Gulf of Oman or the Persian Gulf between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25.
resolution: TRUE if UKMTO reports a merchant vessel attacked, struck, boarded or seized in the Strait of Hormuz, Gulf of Oman or Persian Gulf with an incident date between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25.
failure_condition: No merchant vessel is attacked, struck, boarded or seized in the Strait of Hormuz, Gulf of Oman or Persian Gulf between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25.

statement: A Russian missile or drone strike damages a Ukrainian thermal or hydroelectric power plant or gas-production facility between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01.
resolution: TRUE if Reuters or AP reports, citing Ukrainian officials or the operator, Russian strike damage to a Ukrainian thermal or hydroelectric power plant or gas-production facility occurring between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01.
failure_condition: No Russian strike damages any Ukrainian thermal or hydroelectric power plant or gas-production facility between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01.

statement: The 10-year US Treasury constant-maturity yield is at or above 5.50 percent on at least one trading day between 2026-10-13 and 2026-12-31. Reference: 5.24 percent on the packet date, 2026-10-11.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series DGS10 shows a daily value of 5.50 or higher for any date between 2026-10-13 and 2026-12-31.
failure_condition: The 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield is below 5.50 percent on every trading day between 2026-10-13 and 2026-12-31.

statement: ICE Brent front-month crude futures settle at or above 125.00 US dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-30. Reference: 104.72 dollars per barrel on the packet date, 2026-10-11.
resolution: TRUE if any ICE Futures Europe Brent front-month daily settlement price dated between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-30 is 125.00 US dollars per barrel or higher.
failure_condition: Every ICE Brent front-month daily settlement between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-30 is below 125.00 US dollars per barrel.

statement: CISA adds at least one Apple vulnerability affecting iOS or iPadOS to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog contains an entry with vendorProject Apple, a dateAdded value between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-30, and iOS or iPadOS named in its product or shortDescription field.
failure_condition: CISA adds no Apple vulnerability affecting iOS or iPadOS to the KEV catalog between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-30.

statement: An earthquake of magnitude 6.5 or greater occurs within 250 km of the epicenter of the M7.7 Panama mainshock, USGS event us6000u18k, between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-08 UTC.
resolution: TRUE if USGS ComCat lists an event of magnitude 6.5 or greater with origin time between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-08 UTC located within 250 km of the us6000u18k epicenter.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 6.5 or greater occurs within 250 km of the us6000u18k epicenter between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-08 UTC.

statement: A presidential major disaster declaration naming Isaias is approved for Florida or Alabama between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if the OpenFEMA Disaster Declarations Summaries dataset lists a DR declaration for Florida or Alabama whose title names Isaias, with a declarationDate between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-30.
failure_condition: No major disaster declaration naming Isaias is approved for Florida or Alabama between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-30.

statement: US Senator John Fetterman changes his party affiliation away from the Democratic Party between 2026-10-12 and 2027-03-31.
resolution: TRUE if the Congress.gov member record or the Senate.gov senator list shows Fetterman with a party other than Democratic, with the change effective between 2026-10-12 and 2027-03-31.
failure_condition: Fetterman remains affiliated with the Democratic Party on every date from 2026-10-12 through 2027-03-31.

statement: Polish prosecutors charge at least one person over the alleged plot against Prime Minister Donald Tusk and the defence minister between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-13.
resolution: TRUE if Polish prosecutors announce charges against at least one person over the alleged plot against Tusk or the defence minister between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-13, as reported by PAP or Reuters.
failure_condition: No person is charged by Polish prosecutors over the alleged plot against Tusk or the defence minister between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-13.
